style_deltas.full (preflight): .tl-container font-family: 'Times New Roman' → -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto…; .tl-container line-height: normal → 18px; .tlui-button font family likewise; body margin 8px → 0, line-height normal → 24px. Root cause: preflight resets html/body font-family and .tl-container sets none of its own, so text metrics — and every growY / auto-size measurement built on them — change. Unchanged under both modes: .tl-svg-container display, .tlui-style-panel background/shadow/radius, .tl-text-label__inner font (tldraw sets those explicitly).

shadcn.init_command: npx shadcn@latest init -b base -p nova -t vite -y
shadcn.init_notes: -b base picks the Base UI primitive layer; -p nova is the preset name (base-nova is not accepted as -p); -y alone still prompts for a preset. The CLI refuses a bare Vite scaffold until a @/* → ./src/* alias exists in tsconfig + vite resolve.alias. Under TypeScript ~6.0 the classic baseUrl alias shadcn's docs show raises TS5101 (baseUrl deprecated) and breaks `tsc -b`; vite build alone stays green. Use `paths` without baseUrl, or ignoreDeprecations 6.0.
shadcn.primitive_landed: @base-ui/react@1.8.0 — zero @radix-ui/* or radix-ui in package.json after init + 13 adds
shadcn.import_census: 14 of 14 generated ui/*.tsx import only from @base-ui/react/* (button, button-group, collapsible, input, popover, select, separator, slider, tabs, toggle, toggle-group, tooltip…); zero Radix imports
shadcn.tsc: red on TS5101 (baseUrl deprecated under TS 6) — a tsconfig matter, not a component one
shadcn.build: vite build green (5 chunks; layers css 36.6 kB with shadcn tokens, full css 65.0 kB)

kibo.summary: `npx shadcn add https://www.kibo-ui.com/r/color-picker.json` installed one file and pulled radix-ui@1.6.7 and color@5.0.3 into a project whose components.json style is base-nova — Kibo's source imports `Slider` from radix-ui unconditionally. With the tsconfig deprecation silenced, tsc reports exactly one real error: Kibo's <Select onValueChange={setMode}> was written against Radix's (value: string) signature and Base UI's Select passes string | null. So a Base UI shadcn project and a Kibo item are not composable out of the box: both primitive libraries end up installed, and the item needs a patch to type-check.

screenshots.caption: Baseline. The seeded nine-shape board with only tldraw.css loaded (the aside on the right is the deliberately unstyled control).
Layers-only Tailwind. Amplified ×8 diff against the baseline: the canvas is solid black — 0 of 800,000 pixels changed. Only the aside (which now carries utility classes) lights up.
Full Tailwind with preflight. Same amplification: every shape shows doubled edges, not just its label — the font reset cascaded into .tl-container and moved geometry.
